title: Gary's Actually Great
subject: your ex's new boyfriend turning out to be genuinely nice at a friend's barbecue
caption: Pop-punk revival in the glossy 2000s style. Overdriven humbucker guitars playing palm-muted power chords in the verses and open chords in the chorus, with an octave lead line on top; a driving bass in straight eighths; drums on a straight rock beat in the verses and the skate beat in the choruses, kick on every beat and snare on every off-beat, with crash-heavy hits. Tight, compressed and bright, guitars wide and the voice forward. Male voice, a nasal bright tenor with a sneer, gang 'whoa-oh' backing vocals in the choruses. 172 BPM, E major. Furious that he's nice. No metal breakdowns, no screamed vocals, no synths, no autotune, no tapped emo guitars.
lyrics:
[Intro - palm-muted guitars, four-count on the snare]

[Verse 1]
Jess's barbecue, I brought a bag of ice like armor
She said "heads up, Megan's coming with the new guy"
I had a plan, I'd be funny, I'd be taller somehow
Then he walked in with a homemade pasta salad

[Pre-Chorus]
He remembered my name
He asked about my mom's knee

[Chorus]
Gary's actually great (whoa-oh)
And I hate it, I hate it, I hate it
He fixed the grill and he gave me the last burger
Gary's actually great (whoa-oh)

[Verse 2]
He's a paramedic and he hosts a podcast about trains
He laughed at my joke and it wasn't even a good one
Megan looks happy, like really, really happy
And Gary's teaching Jess's kid to throw a frisbee

[Pre-Chorus]
He doesn't even drink
He drove three people home

[Chorus]
Gary's actually great (whoa-oh)
And I hate it, I hate it, I hate it
He asked if I want to join his bowling team on Thursdays
And I said yes, Gary's actually great

[Outro - skate beat, then a hard stop]
Thursday, lane nine
I bought my own shoes
[Song ends abruptly]
